physical: A changing magnetic flux through a loop induces an electromotive force equal to the rate of change of the flux. (EMF = dΦ_B ÷ dt)
reflected_sentence: A changing Reflected collection through a loop induces conscious energy per source equal to the change of that Reflected collection across Expansion.
rule_reason: Equation with zero resistance-carrying quantities and no separation cost keeps its shape.
interpretation: Reflected and Expansion keep their relationship when zero resistance costs are present. Change in the Reflected partner across Expansion directly yields the induced conscious energy per source.
closing: The rule cleanly decides that the relation keeps its shape (zero costs, no resistance-carrying quantities, no distance separation). Only 'magnetic' (Reflected) and 'time' (Expansion) have direct table entries; 'voltage'/'EMF' and 'flux' go in unmapped_terms.
